title: Circular ring
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees in all axes and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw the first loop as a circle centered at coordinates [0.375, 0.375] with a radius of 0.375. For the second loop, draw another circle with the same center but a smaller radius of 0.3482. Scale the entire two-dimensional sketch uniformly by a factor of 0.75. Rotate and translate the scaled sketch using the same Euler angles and translation vector as initially set. Extrude the sketch along the normal direction by 0.0054 units to create a three-dimensional solid body. Ensure that the extrusion does not extend in the opposite direction. The final dimensions of the circular ring will be 0.75 units in length and width, and 0.005357142857142857 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the initial sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").center(0.375, 0.375)

# Create the outer circle
sketch = sketch.circle(0.375)

# Create the inner circle
sketch = sketch.circle(0.3482)

# Extrude the sketch to create the ring
r = sketch.extrude(0.0054)

# Display the result

import cadquery as cq

# Create the outer circular profile
outer_diameter = 0.75  # Diameter of the outer circle
outer_radius = outer_diameter / 2
outer_profile = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(outer_radius)

# Create the inner circular profile for the hole
inner_diameter = 0.7  # Diameter of the inner circle
inner_radius = inner_diameter / 2
inner_profile = cq.Workplane("XY").circle(inner_radius)

# Subtract the inner profile from the outer profile to create the ring
ring = outer_profile.extrude(0.0054).cut(inner_profile.extrude(0.0054))

# Assign the result to a variable named r
r = ring
